row: Dr. Jayant Manchanda - Healing Hands Chiropractor

As a leading manual therapist with an MPT in Orthopedics, Dr. Jayant Manchanda and his dedicated team, based in Delhi, India, specialize in chiropractic and osteopathic practices (HVT). Our expertise spans orthopedic & neurological cases, &we are committed to providing precise clinical diagnoses with minimal interventions.

At Dr. Jayant Manchanda's Healing Hands, we prioritize holistic healing. Our approach involves a comprehensive assessment, pinpoint diagnosis, &applying advanced manual skills to promote recovery without excessive reliance on investigations or medications.

Subscribe to our channel for valuable insights, expert tips, & a closer look at the transformative power of chiropractic & osteopathic care.

WE ARE PROUD TO BE THE ONLY CLINIC GLOBALLY SHOWCASING RESULTS EVEN ON X-RAYS AND MRI SCANS.
